title: Denver City Highlights - Private Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult
Meet at Denver Union Station on corner of 17th and Wynkoop by large Flagpole
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Denver’s history is rich in stories, pioneers, art and culture – more than you probably ever imagined. Come on a journey through time, from Denver’s Wild West as the “gateway to the Rockies” to more recent history and influences, and learn about the people who shaped the city with their pioneering spirit. After the tour is over, you will see Denver with different eyes.
